human_actions_pending.action: Walk the design gallery and report what you see
human_actions_pending.context: 03-07 built the gallery — the first thing in Phase 3 that renders. Stop any running debug session first (03-07 touched a .g.dart the session already compiled, and a running build holds a WebView2Loader.dll lock). Run with --dart-define=GW_DEV_TOOLS=true, press Dev > Gallery, confirm: 14 sections render; 'Canvas background (noise texture)' shows visible grain in DARK mode (dark-only by design); 'Mesh background' shows animated blobs in both modes; console has NO 'Unable to load asset' for noise.png (this is DS-04's real test); the closure-canary section shows a count. Then quit, re-run with no define, confirm Dev/Gallery absent. If the canvas texture does not render, report whether the console shows an asset error — that distinguishes a bundling failure from a paint failure.

decisions.decision: Take Alex Faber's visual only — never his behavior or his branch-only features
decisions.rationale: His .planning/WIRING.md documents 11 WIRE-N stubs: Send shows 'submitted (demo)' and never broadcasts, swap quotes are mocked, recipient validation is length>=6, '1,000' parses to 1.0 (1000x under-send), dashboard 24h delta is balance*0.024. Six touch money. develop has the real implementations. Copied to .planning/ALEX-WIRING.md
Applying an adopted design system to existing widgets is a translation with a right answer; moving items or adding capability is a product judgement with no owner in this milestone

decisions.decision: Run plans SEQUENTIALLY, never in parallel
decisions.rationale: Phase 2 Wave 1 ran two executors concurrently; they share one working tree and one git index, and one agent's staged file was swept into the other's commit. files_modified does not protect the staging area

decisions.decision: Three shadow classes land inert, guarded mechanically
decisions.rationale: Alex's branch has 3 class-name collisions with develop at different paths, producing NO compile error: Loading (canonical has 19 importers), Splash (canonical is the BOOT PATH via router.dart:30 — Alex DELETED the canonical so his source presents the swap as finished), WalletsOverview (inside an analyzer-blind .g.dart, filename differs by one letter). tool/verify_additive_boundary.sh pins each canonical's exact importer set and re-derives the duplicate-class census against tool/shadow-baseline.txt

decisions.decision: The closure canary is how the 9 .g.dart files are gated
decisions.rationale: analysis_options.yaml:5 excludes lib/**/*.g.dart — flutter analyze reports 0 errors even if they are broken. lib/dev/generated_closure_canary.dart is NOT a .g.dart, so the exclude doesn't apply; the gallery imports it, making the set reachable from an entry point so the compiler actually compiles the bodies. This is not theoretical — it caught 2 real compile errors in wallet_information.g.dart that analyze had passed

context_notes: Phase 3 is 7/10 plans done; the 50/50 component port is COMPLETE and every file is cmp-verified byte-identical to Alex's original except 6 documented mechanical deviations (3 missing Phase 2 tokens: brandGreen/btnDisabled/gray500, each ported verbatim after verifying zero prior references; Icon->FaIcon for font_awesome_flutter ^11 vs Alex's ^10.8; isNativeApp()->isMobileApp() for a develop breakpoints.dart API delta; Alex's Splash repointed off the Loading shadow to the canonical). The guard has exited 0 on all ~19 commits and flutter analyze lib has stayed at 0 errors throughout (62 info/warnings is the current baseline, up from 34 — the delta is the ported files' own pre-existing lint surface, deliberately not 'improved'). Standing method that has repeatedly paid off: make every agent RE-DERIVE rather than inherit. Doing so caught wrong file counts I fed in (43 vs the real 60 — I had diffed against the incomplete forward-port branch instead of Alex's), two silently-missing files, a broken guard that would have red-lighted a clean checkout, and 2 compile errors the analyzer is configured not to see.
